card.name: Past-tense narrative storytelling
card.fires_on: Words inside past-tense narrative in general web prose, often an auxiliary or verb right after a subject (been, had, would, wanted, were), or a sentence-opening "As". It reads like a story or anecdote about past events.

modes.label: Auxiliary or verb in past narrative
modes.description: A helper or main verb partway through a past-tense clause about events or people.
modes.example: The growth of the empire had for some time<< been>> an impediment to European trade.

modes.label: Sentence-opening As
modes.description: The word As starting a reflective sentence after a story.
modes.example: . After all they had now completed the unit on operations. <<As>> I reflect on this story I feel sad

card.plain: It lights up on small words in the middle of a story told about the past, such as been, had or would.
